nodes.asset_description: A minimalist still-life of skincare products—white tube atop a beaker of coffee, a clear pump bottle filled with coffee beans, two droppers, and a small cream jar—arranged neatly. Warm peach and coral geometric background contrasts with the clean white packaging and dark coffee beans scattered in the foreground.

A minimalist still life shows a white funnel on a tripod surrounded by clear glass dropper bottles, two white pump bottles, a dark liquid bottle, and a few coffee beans. Set against a warm peach background, the bright whites and transparent glass create crisp contrasts with hard, sunlit shadows.

A minimalist flat lay of skincare containers—a white squeeze tube, glass dropper bottle, small cream jar, and a dark vial with a gold cap—arranged on a peach background. Warm light casts soft, long shadows, with a few coffee beans and a corner of green leaves adding contrast.

A minimalist still life shows a white ceramic vessel, a dark amber dropper bottle with a gold collar, and a clear dropper bottle filled with coffee beans, with a few beans scattered in front. Warm peach/orange background and hard studio lighting create crisp shadows and a clean, modern composition.

A minimalist graphic shows a centered white diamond (a rotated square with slightly rounded corners) on a solid black background. The composition is symmetrical, high-contrast, and dominated by clean lines and negative space.
